title: Make QueryBuilder's or, and, optional methods take FnOnce.
body:
# Objective

- QueryBuilder has `and`, `or`, and `optional` which all take `Fn` currently, but these methods only ever call the function once! This unnecessarily restricts the caller to using only functions that could be called multiple times. In other words, users can't pass in closures that consume a value (e.g., an iterator of component IDs).

## Solution

- Use FnOnce for these methods.
    - Since `Fn: FnOnce`, no migration guide is needed. Any `Fn` will continue to compile!

## Testing

- None.
